title: A fantastic trip for the family, with insights and an intimate feel
text:
Javi was a great tour guide and driver to Cordoba. We stopped at Carmona on the way back to have another feel for a small town. We had our meals with Javi, and he talked to us about local foods and traditions. He also recommended places to go in Sevilla. He was amazing!
Jose was our local tour guide in Cordoba. He knew so many details and fun facts about the mosque-Cathedral, the city and Jewish quarter.
In summary, a fantastic trip!
author: MONICA_G
